title: VeloraOS 1.10.51 - Chat Task Image Routing Hotfix
releaseNotes: Fixes the 500 Internal Server Error in Chat task creation introduced by 1.10.50 image payload hardening.
Creates and validates clean chat messages before model and Image Intelligence routing.
Returns a clear invalid-image message instead of a backend crash when an uploaded image cannot be decoded.
Uses validated image state for vision routing, task metadata and web-search decisions.
Keeps PNG/JPEG payload hardening, Image Intelligence, GPU-first inference and licence soft-lock.
